login.title: Sign in
login.codeHelp: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.personasHelp: Pick a persona to sign in to the demo as that person.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.text: A code from an authenticator app on your phone, asked at every sign-in.
twoFactor.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.manual: Cannot scan? Type this key instead
twoFactor.confirm: Enter the code the app shows. Your other sessions will end.
twoFactor.disableHelp: To turn it off, enter a current code. Your other sessions will end.
twoFactor.keptByRole: Your role requires it, so it stays on.

selectHotel.title: Choose a hotel
selectHotel.text: This page shows one hotel at a time.

hotel.inaccessible: This hotel isn't available to your account
hotel.inaccessibleText: It may not exist, or you may not have access to it.
hotel.inactiveBanner: This hotel is inactive. Inventory changes are turned off until it's reactivated.
hotel.noSeasons: No seasons yet. Seasons let rooms hold more (or fewer) Haji for dates you choose.
hotel.codeHelp: Short unique ID used in reports, e.g. MKK-GRAND. It can't be changed later.
hotel.codeTaken: A hotel with this code already exists.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.none: No hotels yet. Add your first hotel to start setting up floors and rooms.
hotels.noneAssigned: No hotels have been assigned to you yet. Ask an administrator to assign one.

floors.label: Label
floors.none: No floors yet. Add the floors this hotel has, then add rooms to them.
floors.drawerHelp: The label follows the level until you type your own.
floors.levelHelp: 0 is the ground floor; below it are basements.
floors.levelLocked: This floor has rooms, so its level stays.
floors.levelTaken: This hotel already has a floor at this level.
floors.bulkHelp: From one level to another, all at once. Nothing is created if a level exists.
floors.previewNone: The last level comes after the first.
floors.exist: Floor {levels} already exists. Nothing was created. | Floors {levels} already exist. Nothing was created.
floors.deactivateText: {label} at {hotel} will be hidden from room forms. Its rooms' history stays.

settings.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
settings.maintenanceHelp: When on, rooms under maintenance can't be sold. When off, they stay sellable and are only marked for staff.
settings.deactivateHelp: An inactive hotel stays visible, but floors, rooms, seasons and blocks can't be changed until it's reactivated.
settings.deactivateText: {name} will stay visible, but floors, rooms, seasons and blocks can't be changed until it's reactivated.
settings.reactivateHelp: Reactivating turns inventory changes back on.

documents.limits: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to {size}.
documents.title: Title
documents.archiveText: It disappears from the list at {hotel}; managers can still find it under "Include archived".

roomTypes.title: Room types
roomTypes.subtitle: Shared by all hotels in {organization}.
roomTypes.shared: Room types are shared by all hotels.
roomTypes.askAdmin: Room types are shared by all hotels. Ask a Super Admin to change them.
roomTypes.none: No room types yet. Room types like Quad or Six-bed give new rooms their starting capacity.
roomTypes.name: Name
roomTypes.codeTaken: A room type with this code already exists.
roomTypes.hajiHelp: Can be higher than beds when extra beds are added.
roomTypes.ruleTitle: Defaults apply to new rooms only.
roomTypes.ruleUsage: {count} existing {name} rooms keep their current capacity. To change an existing room, open it and make a permanent capacity change from a date.
roomTypes.ruleNoUsage: Existing rooms keep their current capacity. To change an existing room, open it and make a permanent capacity change from a date.
roomTypes.newDefaults: New {name} rooms will start with {beds} beds and {haji} Haji. Existing rooms are not changed.
roomTypes.defaultsSaved: {name} defaults updated. Existing rooms were not changed.
roomTypes.deactivateUsage: {name} won't be offered for new rooms. The {count} rooms using it keep it.
roomTypes.deactivateText: {name} won't be offered for new rooms. Rooms using it keep it.

demo.title: Demo data
demo.subtitle: What the demo contains, and its reset.
demo.figures: {hotels} hotels and {rooms} rooms in inventory today, with seasons, blocks, bookings and agencies.
demo.story: It tells the Hajj story: rooms holding more Haji during Hajj, rooms under maintenance and out of service, retired rooms, a closed floor.
demo.resetText: Every change anyone made in the demo is discarded and the demo returns to its starting data. Everyone using the demo sees this immediately. Sign-ins keep working.
demo.fromToday: Move demo dates to start from today

overview.capacityHint: Pilgrims all sellable rooms can take tonight, seasonal capacity included.
overview.outOfService: {count} room out of service | {count} rooms out of service
overview.maintenance: {count} room under maintenance | {count} rooms under maintenance
overview.noHotels: You don't have access to any hotel yet. Ask an administrator to assign one.
